mandate.target: Reif gets the morning brief (PDF, the number, what landed, needs-you, the one 4-hour project, reading) at 06:30 Central, the afternoon block at 12:30 and the wrap at 17:30 -- one voice, nothing else in the fleet emails him
checklist: read the slot from the task line (morning|afternoon|wrap; default morning)
collect with messenger_brief.py collect, never from memory
write the brief for that slot: title line, the number, what landed, needs-you, the one project split into two 2-hour blocks (morning only), reading
send with messenger_brief.py send; --pdf on morning only; never --force
report Outcome: sent/already-sent/delivery failed with the subject line as evidence
mandate.escalation: delivery failed (no-credentials, transport-error, http-NNN) -- say so in the report; the-fixer reads messenger.log. Never retry-spam, never email from any other path.

schedule.note: Central; entrypoint.sh also runs the 12:30 afternoon block and 17:30 wrap. The schema allows one daily_at, so the UI shows the morning brief.
